codeReview.summary: Core animation controls were implemented, but replay/start semantics are broken after reaching route end (and when switching routes) because animation distance state is never reset.

issues.description: Animation only starts when `currentDistance < totalLength`, but `currentDistance` is never reset after completion or route change. Once line 45 clamps distance to `totalLength`, pressing Play again (or starting a different activity with shorter route) does not restart from the route start, violating expected Play/start behavior.
